rows.name: preabort-before-acquisition
rows.procedure: Use each bounded falsy/object caller reason; reached regex must preserve identity with no Worker acquisition or BASH_REMATCH publication. Skipped regex must not create a session either.
rows.basis: ROOT project profile and frozen source reasoning, NOT native goldens
rows.qualification: No acquisition dynamically observable; no publication after preabort is SOURCE-qualified, not an external state snapshot.

rows.name: abort-owned-worker
rows.procedure: Gate an admitted actual matcher job, abort caller, observe exact reason and registered job/session retirement before public settlement. Gate/release must not create circular cleanup. No opaque-provider ownership inference.
rows.basis: ROOT project profile and frozen source reasoning, NOT native goldens

rows.name: grammar-and-logical-limits
rows.procedure: Preseal exact boundary/one-over group/node/depth/interval fixtures and modest branching work/state exhaustion. Check preallocation refusals, no partial match/capture publication and no parent Budget reset; do not use oversized bombs.
rows.basis: ROOT project profile and frozen source reasoning, NOT native goldens

rows.name: capture-ledger
rows.procedure: Preseal sums of nested overlapping captures, target replacement with old snapshots alive, F/metadata/ticket boundaries and retirement failures. Distinguish worker envelope, private array ledger and E_command; no lowered-private-hook result presented as default proof.
rows.basis: ROOT project profile and frozen source reasoning, NOT native goldens

rows.name: concurrent-stale-and-readonly
rows.procedure: Gate between post-operand target snapshot and publication; mutate through actual context.invoke to readonly/unrelated epoch/local restoration. Caller wins, then readonly before stale. No retry/state injection as public proof.
rows.basis: ROOT project profile and frozen source reasoning, NOT native goldens

rows.name: diagnostic-sink-and-cleanup
rows.procedure: Reject/gate exact redirected diagnostic sink for syntax and readonly routes, combine caller and registered cleanup errors, retain primary reason/backpressure. No false/no-match conversion; no blanket expected status1.
rows.basis: ROOT project profile and frozen source reasoning, NOT native goldens
rows.qualification: Sink routes only; cleanup/barrier combinations remain explicitly gated under EH04.

rows.name: reply-and-loaded-binding

rows.name: shared-budget-and-snapshots
rows.procedure: Two internal conditional descendants/context.invoke share admitted work and array ledger; fresh independent public exec uses established fresh boundary. Verify ordinary local, global and cloned state, recursive calls and byte-exact capture reads. Do not infer cross-exec RSS bounds.
rows.basis: ROOT project profile and frozen source reasoning, NOT native goldens
